in_sanskrit.name: Heera
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Star, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Heera एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Heera means star or radiant. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘heeram’, which signifies brilliance or luminosity. In Hindu mythology, Heera is associated with the stars and is a symbol of beauty, power, and grace.
